test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The data was not analysed by the researchers carefully.

options.text: The researchers have not analysed the data carefully.
The researchers do not analyse the data carefully.
The researchers did not analyse the data carefully.
The researchers had not analysed the data carefully.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the **simple past tense**, which describes an action that occurred in the past.
 
• It is in the passive voice and **"The data"** is the subject and "**the researchers"** is the object.
 
• **Passive voice sentence structure:*** "Subject + was/were + past participle (of the main verb) + by + Object".*
 
• In this case *"*The data was not analyzed carefully by the researchers.*"*
 
• When we convert this sentence into active voice, the subject **"The data"** of the passive voice becomes the object, and the object **"the researchers"** becomes the subject.
 
• So, the active format** "did not + analyse"** should be used.
 
• Following the above structure, we get the correct active voice: **"The researchers did not analyse the data carefully."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3**".
